source: Apple marketingtools RSS top-free/top-grossing charts (US/GB/CA storefronts, top 100) + iTunes Lookup API rating counts (US) for a hand-verified 16-app watchlist
license: Apple public RSS/Lookup feeds — CONDITIONAL on low-volume internal use (this stream: ~28 calls/day, well under any documented Apple cap). Google Play is NOT included: robots.txt + ToS prohibit programmatic collection, stated honestly rather than silently omitted. Apple customer-reviews RSS is verified dead, not attempted.
attribution: Apple Inc. (App Store charts + iTunes Lookup)

field_map.key: dedup key: rank = rt|storefront|chart|ticker; rating = rt|ticker
field_map.ticker: public-company ticker from the hand-verified watchlist (server/appStoreRankings.ts WATCHLIST)
field_map.appId: Apple App Store numeric trackId, verified live against sellerName/bundleId 2026-08-01 — never name-guessed
field_map.storefront: Apple storefront country code (us|gb|ca) — 3 of ~175 countries, a scoping choice
field_map.rank: 1-100 chart position, or null if the app is outside the top 100 THAT DAY — never fabricated as a worst-case number
field_map.avgRating: iTunes Lookup averageUserRating (US storefront), or null if unavailable
field_map.ratingCount: iTunes Lookup userRatingCount (US storefront) — the review-VELOCITY proxy (delta day over day)
field_map.version: current app version string at snapshot time, or null
field_map.rt: as-seen UTC date (day WE fetched it)

confidence_model: GATE 1 (DATA) only — this manifest covers the raw archiver. Ladder next step (GATE 2, not yet run): quarterly rank/velocity aggregates vs company-REPORTED usage metrics (DUOL DAU/bookings, RBLX bookings) as the EIA-equivalent ground truth, then vs forward returns. SOBER PRIOR stated before building (research/open_questions.md NEW DATA ROOTS #3): app-store data is the MOST arbitraged alt-data category — expect near-zero edge on these names; the archive itself, not a claimed edge, is this session's deliverable. HONEST GAPS: no downloads/revenue figures are free anywhere (ordinal rank is the only volume proxy); Android is entirely dark (ToS-blocked); overall charts miss genre-#1 apps outside the top 100 overall (rank:null, not a synthetic worst rank).
cadence: 6h poll (7 requests/cycle: 3 storefronts x 2 charts + 1 US ratings batch lookup, ~28 calls/day)
_note: Universal archive envelope (approved 2026-07-04): dataset-level manifest; datum-level fields where information varies per record. Append-only JSONL unless stated; readers pick field_map from here.
